value: non-stratified seeds germinated about 10% more under 16 h or 24 h light than in darkness (25 C, scored at day 10); the same test gave E. purpurea about 7% more germination in the dark and E. pallida no light effect (species by light, P = 0.001); after 4 weeks cold-moist stratification, E. angustifolia stratified in 24 h darkness had the lowest germination (64%), about 10 points below seeds stratified under 24 h light
method: seeds in Petri dishes germinated at 25 C under 24 h light, 24 h dark or 16/8 h light/dark (cool-white fluorescent, 32 umol m-2 s-1); radicle of 2 mm or more counted as germinated; a second experiment gave 4 weeks at 4 C under the same three light regimes before germination
conditions: light test (Experiment 2) used one commercial lot only (Johnny's Selected Seeds, lot 17882), 3 replicates of 50 seeds per treatment, repeated in 2004; absolute percentages are in Figure 1 and not given in the text read; the stratification experiment pooled all three species for its overall light effect (P = 0.0012 at day 3, 0.0029 at day 10) and did not state the seed lot
